title: Traditional & Modern Medicine Research Lab
objective: Complete sample-centric workflow for traditional and modern medicine research from initial sample intake through product formulation and archival
protocol: TMMRD - Traditional & Modern Medicine Research & Development
content: 8-stage comprehensive workflow: (1) Sample Intake & Registration, (2) Authentication, (3) Storage & Herbarium, (4) Sample Preparation, (5) Extraction, (6) Analytical Pathways (dual-path), (7) Product Development & Testing, (8) Formulation & Archival per TMMRD SRS

pages.title: Sample Intake, Reception & Registration
pages.instructions: STAGE 1 (SRS) - Receive plant materials or traditional medicine samples. Record metadata: origin, species, collector, date/time, sample condition. Two-phase workflow: Sample Receipt -> Registration & Labeling.
pages.content: Sample Intake, Reception & Registration - Plant material and traditional medicine sample reception

pages.title: Authentication
pages.instructions: STAGE 2 (SRS) - Botanical verification or expert identification. Methods: Morphological examination, Microscopic analysis, Molecular identification (DNA barcoding: ITS, rbcL, matK genes). Document method used, result (species confirmed, uncertain, misidentified), authenticator name and date. Link to herbarium specimen if prepared.

pages.title: Storage & Herbarium Placement
pages.instructions: STAGE 3 (SRS) - Assign storage location based on sample condition. Fresh (2-8°C), Dried (room temp), Preserved (fixative/alcohol). Create herbarium specimen record if needed.
pages.content: Storage & Herbarium Placement - Sample preservation and herbarium management

pages.title: Sample Preparation for Analysis
pages.instructions: STAGE 4 (SRS) - Physical processing of samples. Freshly processed or drying (air, oven, freeze). Preparation methods: Grinding, Chopping, Powdering. Document: Method, weight before/after, yield (%), date, operator. Create child/processed samples from original material.
pages.content: Sample Preparation for Analysis - Physical processing and preparation

pages.title: Extraction, Filtration & Concentration
pages.instructions: STAGE 5 (SRS) - Extract compounds from prepared plant material. Solvents: Ethanol, methanol, water, hexane, chloroform. Techniques: Maceration, Soxhlet, Ultrasonic, Distillation. Remove impurities via filtration. Concentrate extract via evaporation or distillation. Document: Solvent, plant weight, technique, temp, duration, yields, operator. Create aliquots/child samples from extracts.
pages.content: Extraction, Filtration & Concentration - Compound extraction and processing

pages.title: Analytical Pathways
pages.instructions: STAGE 6 (SRS) - Dual-path decision point. PATH A: Advanced Analysis (Fractionation via chromatography, Identification/Isolation via TLC/HPLC/GC-MS/LC-MS, Purification via recrystallization/HPLC, Characterization via NMR/MS/IR-FTIR, store spectral data). PATH B: Direct to Production (skip analysis, proceed to formulation). User selects path based on research needs.
pages.content: Analytical Pathways - Dual-path decision (Advanced Analysis or Direct Production)

pages.title: Product Development & Testing
pages.instructions: STAGE 7 (SRS) - Preliminary phytochemical screening (Alkaloids, Flavonoids, Tannins, Saponins, Terpenoids, Glycosides, Others). Safety/Toxicity studies (in vitro, in vivo, LD50, NOAEL). Efficacy tests (antimicrobial, antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, anticancer). Document outcomes and protocols. Three-way approval: Approve, Further Testing, Reject.
pages.content: Product Development & Testing - Phytochemical, safety, and efficacy testing

pages.title: Formulation of Medical Product
pages.instructions: STAGE 8 (SRS) - Select formulation type (Capsules, Tinctures, Ointments/creams, Teas, Syrups, Others). Record: Ingredients with quantities/concentrations, Manufacturing steps, Batch number, Manufacturing date. Product QC: Stability testing, Microbial contamination, Heavy metals, Pesticide residues, Active constituent quantification.
pages.content: Formulation of Medical Product - Product formulation and QC testing
